caption: The drawing features two identical, metallic objects positioned side by side against a plain off-white background. Both objects are pitcher-shaped with a slender, curved handle attached from the top to the midsection on one side. The bodies are bulbous in the center and taper towards the top and bottom, ending in a narrow neck with a round, flat-topped lid. Each object stands on a circular, tiered base. The color of the pitchers is primarily silvery gray, with gradient shading that creates the appearance of a reflective metallic surface. The handles and bases display darker outlining to define the edges and separate the components. The two objects are horizontally aligned, spaced apart without touching, and set against an otherwise unadorned background.
title: Pewter Salt and Pepper Shakers
